Privacy

AILawyer is configured not to collect or retain chat content, contact details or site-level query logs. Do not submit names, identity numbers, addresses, case numbers, confidential documents or other personal information.

No accounts or follow-up collection

There is no sign-up, login or contact form. The assistant does not ask for a name, email address, phone number or other contact details and cannot arrange personal follow-up. Ask only general questions that do not identify anyone.

Your conversation

Your current messages are processed to produce the reply shown in the open browser session. They are not written to the site’s lead database or site-level query log, and the site does not build an advertising profile from them.

Third parties

To generate an answer, the question text is processed through the site’s infrastructure and language-model provider. Do not use the assistant for material that must remain confidential.

Basic website operation

The delivery infrastructure may process limited technical request information needed for security, reliability and content delivery. The site does not sell personal information or use advertising profiles.
